images.chapterTitle: Chapter उन्नीस — कृष्ण द्वारा मुञ्जारण्य में महाग्नि से रक्षा
images.prompt: In the center of the blazing Munjavaranya forest, the terrified cowherds press close around Krishna, clasping his hands and garments, desperately seeking his protection. Krishna stands calm and reassuring, gently instructing all the cowherds and Balarama to close their eyes tightly. The surrounding inferno roars with crackling flames while cows and calves press together in fear, the intense orange firelight illuminating every face.
images.caption:
📖 Srimad Bhagavatam — Canto 10, Chapter 166
Chapter उन्नीस — कृष्ण द्वारा मुञ्जारण्य में महाग्नि से रक्षा

A scene from Srimad Bhagavatam — the timeless wisdom of the Supreme Lord, narrated for the upliftment of all souls.

🙏 Hare Krishna
